args.code: (() => { try { const save = localStorage.getItem('farm_game_save_v1'); if (!save) return {error: 'No save found', keys: Object.keys(localStorage)}; const data = JSON.parse(save); return {success: true, day: data.day, season: data.season, daysPlayed: data.daysPlayed, money: data.money, stamina: data.stamina, maxStamina: data.maxStamina, health: data.health, maxHealth: data.maxHealth, fields: data.fields?.length, weather: data.weather, mode: data.mode, disasterRate: data.disasterRate, skills: data.skills, npcs: data.npcs, npcMilestones: data.npcMilestones, reputation: data.reputation, mood: data.mood, quests: data.quests?.length, events: data.eventHistory?.length, researchPoints: data.researchPoints, storageCapacity: data.storageCapacity, pets: data.pets?.length, house: data.house, totalHarvest: data.stats?.totalHarvest, totalSell: data.stats?.totalSell, workers: data.workers?.length, fishPond: data.fishPond}; } catch(e) { return {error: e.message}; } })()
